candidates.title: Interactive Custom Pet Preview Studio Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new pet preview studio screen right after photo uploads to allow users to inspect and customize pet rendering before finalizing adoption.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple tickets about custom pet rendering failures, and adoption has the lowest step conversion at 60.9%.

new_pet_preview_studio.headline: Preview Your Custom Desktop Companion
new_pet_preview_studio.body: Inspect your pet's 3D desktop lighting and animation details before issuing your official certificate.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a custom pet preview studio screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses the lowest conversion step (60.9%) backed by rendering failure tickets, but requires a whole new screen.

candidates.title: Account Cloud Sync & Pet Recovery Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated cloud sync screen after sign-in that automatically scans and confirms existing pet save data restoration.
candidates.why: The top support theme (8 emails) is pets missing or being reset after signing in again.

new_cloud_sync_verification.headline: Verifying Cloud Save Data
new_cloud_sync_verification.body: We are syncing your account records to guarantee your pet profiles and items are safely preserved.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a cloud save sync screen after sign in.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets top support theme (8 emails) at sign_in, though adding a full screen increases friction.

candidates.title: Split Diagnostic Waiting Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the waiting screen into a split layout with asset progress on the left and a live desktop rendering diagnostic checklist on the right.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s, and users reported pets failing to appear on the desktop.

waiting.headline: Building Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: Preparing screen overlay graphics and loading your pet's behavioral animations.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the waiting screen that retains its job of showing the pet is being made.

candidates.score_note: Home step conversion is already high (89.2%), but redesign addresses long 201s wait time and support reports.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Control Dock Setup Flow
candidates.change: Replaces standard completion text with an interactive tutorial flow where users test hiding, summoning, and talking to their pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to the desktop pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Master Your Desktop Controls
home_intro.body: Try key shortcuts now to easily summon, hide, or talk to your pet anytime.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Cloud Save Guarantee Hint on Adoption Certificate
candidates.change: Adds a cloud persistence hint on the adoption certificate screen reassuring users that pet ownership is permanently linked to their account.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets following account login.

adoption_certificate.hint: This adoption certificate is permanently bound to your account and backed up to the cloud.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a cloud persistence hint on the adoption certificate screen.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint targeting adoption drop-off, though support emails focus more on post-sign-in persistence.

candidates.title: Split Trait Comparison Layout for Pet Selection
candidates.change: Changes the pick_friend screen layout to a two-column split view displaying detailed personality traits alongside live previews.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate (60.9% conversion) and long completion times.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Compare personality traits and desktop behaviors side by side.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of pick_friend screen while retaining pet selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop-off step and 89s completion time, though lacks specific support email alignment.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Engine Initialization Diagnostic
candidates.change: Displays real-time diagnostic status updates on the waiting screen to notify users of screen coordinate verification.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported that the pet does not show up on the desktop or the app fails to open.

waiting.hint: Checking display resolution and multi-monitor compatibility...

guard.reason: Valid display diagnostic status hint added to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Easy diagnostic text update for home step, but home already converts well at 89.2%.

candidates.title: Starter Accessory Unlock Badge Incentive
candidates.change: Adds a badge highlight on choose_path path cards showing exclusive bonus starter items unlocked per path.
candidates.why: Path selection drop-off is 20.9% with a high mean decision time of 514s.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions bonus starter items, violating the prohibition against mentioning gifts or free extras.

candidates.title: System Tray Quick-Control Desktop Notification
candidates.change: Enables a ready notification banner explaining how to interact with the pet via the system tray icon upon reaching home_intro.
candidates.why: Users expressed post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click the system tray icon anytime to access controls or hide your pet.

guard.reason: Valid notification banner and desktop control tip added to home_intro.

candidates.score_note: Helps finish step completion by addressing post-onboarding pet control confusion.

candidates.title: Account Recovery Reassurance Copy on Sign-In
candidates.change: Updates sign-in title and body copy to emphasize automatic account recovery and instant pet restoration.
candidates.why: Address user hesitation and confusion around account resets and missing pet data.

sign_in.headline: Sign In & Restore Your Pets
sign_in.body: Log in to seamlessly access your existing desktop pets, custom skins, and cloud progress.

guard.reason: Valid copy update on the sign-in screen maintaining its core functionality.

candidates.score_note: Config-only copy change targeting top support complaints during sign_in with zero development overhead.

picked: Interactive Custom Pet Preview Studio Screen
Account Recovery Reassurance Copy on Sign-In

decisions.title: Account Recovery Reassurance Copy on Sign-In
